Breeding Insight has developed several open-source R packages to handle breeding and genomics data
in both diploid in polyploid species.

These packages can help with processing genotype files, performing GWAS/GS,
optimizing mating schemes, estimating ploidy and copy number variation,
validating parentage, visualizing results, and much more.

Some packages can be installed through [Breedverse](https://github.com/Breeding-Insight/Breedverse),
a modular point-and-click app that lets users install tools and run genomic analyses without needing
to be proficient in R.

Use the filters at right to narrow the catalog by task or technology.
